text:
Jen: Quick heads-up — deploybot just flagged a proposed unpin of runtime-2.15 from the canary cohort to prod for the night window (02:00 UTC). Planning to run a small traffic ramp and monitor longseq tail latency.

deploybot: Automated proposal: unpin runtime-2.15 -> target=prod; window=2026-03-24T02:00Z; canary=eu-west; prechecks=kv-cache-health,telemetry-heartbeat. Reply with :approve: or :hold:.

Marco: tagging @Sara @Alan — we still have the SDK 3.x longseq workaround in staging only. If runtime unpins tonight that could expose the issue.

Sara: Confirming — SDK patch for the longseq buffer lands in 3.1.2 tomorrow morning, not yet backfilled to the hosted SDK service. If we unpin tonight some customers might hit degraded throughput.

Alan: How many customers on the longseq path in eu-west? Can we do a targeted routing for those models instead of blocking global unpin?

Jen: We have ~5 live customers with high longseq usage in eu-west (internal list). Options: 1) Delay unpin 12h, 2) Proceed but keep runtime-2.14 as sticky fallback for model-group longseq, 3) Roll targeted routing to dedicated pool for those customers. Thoughts?

Marco: Option 2 minimal blast radius. We can add a routing rule: if model.family=="longseq" -> runtime=2.14. Quick config tweak in deploybot.

deploybot: Suggested config snippet for routing rule:
```
route_rules:
  - when: request.metadata.model_family == "longseq"
    action: route_to_runtime
    runtime: runtime-2.14
    priority: 100
```

Sara: That looks fine. We'd still want telemetry alerts for increased OOMs or latency > 2x baseline for 30m. Can ops add alerts?

ops-bot: Alert set: eu-west longseq tail latency > 2x baseline for 30m -> notify #eng-oncall and #eng-releases. Escalation: oncall -> SRE lead.

Alan: If we go with routing rule, can we also add a temporary release note blurb and pin the rollout to 20% for the first hour? I want a quick rollback path.

Jen: Agreed. Plan: (A) Apply routing rule as deploybot snippet, (B) unpin runtime-2.15 at 02:00 UTC with rollout=20% 1h, (C) monitor alerts, (D) SDK patch in morning and then remove rule. If any sign of regression we rollback to pinned runtime globally.

Marco: I will push the routing rule now to a staging config and post the PR link.

Marco: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploy-configs/pull/774 — staging applied, smoke pass ok.

Sara: :thumbsup: set on the PR. Ops, please confirm alerting is live.

ops-bot: Alerting verified. First-run smoke checks will post to #eng-releases-metrics.

Jen: Thanks. I'm going to mark this thread as :approve: for the unpin with the routing rule and 20% gated rollout. If anything changes call an immediate hold.

Alan: Noted. I'll be online during the window.

deploybot: Action queued: unpin runtime-2.15 -> prod at 2026-03-24T02:00Z; rollout=20%; prechecks passed.

Jen: Copy. I'll draft a short release note for customers: "Minor runtime upgrade to 2.15 — targeted routing will keep long-sequence models on the previous runtime temporarily while the SDK patch completes." Will post to releases channel 30m before.

Sara: One more thing — please add the SDK ticket number to the release note: SDK-1129.

Jen: Added. End of thread."
